notes:
- New look: menus (File, Edit, View, Help) and a toolbar along the top, an icon tool rail over the view with tips that name each tool and its key, and a status bar along the bottom.
- Scene list at the top right. After a build, every mold shell piece is in a Mold Shell folder, and a piece split to fit your printer gets a folder of its own inside it. The eye on a folder hides or shows everything in it; the eye on a row hides or shows just that part.
- X / Y / Z axes in the corner of the view turn with it. Click one to look down it.
- The legend and the overhang gauge sit along the bottom of the view, with counts.
- New keys: C add a cut, S scale box, R / Shift+R turn 90° / 15°, H hide the picked row in the Scene list, Alt+H show everything, X overhangs on or off, T test slices on or off, N hide the side panel, Ctrl+S save the layout, Ctrl+B build the shell.
